title: A viewer-only decade builds on macOS
body:
The viewer is part of the decade binary, and Jack's only other machine is a MacBook.

## Proposal

The compositor, the server and anything else Linux-specific compile only on Linux, behind cfg gates. On macOS, decade builds as a viewer alone.
close_reason: 2cae090 gates every Linux-only module and dependency, and cargo check passes for aarch64-apple-darwin. On macOS decade is a placeholder until remote viewing (decade-e3a784) gives it something to show.
